name: Station Conference Tokyo
address: Tokyo 100-0005 Sapia Tower 4F-6F, 1-7-12 Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo
accessSummary: Directly connected to the Nihombashi Exit of JR Tokyo Station (1 min walk from the Shinkansen Nihombashi Exit ticket gate / 2 min walk from the Yaesu North Exit ticket gate) / Tokyo Metro Tozai Line Otemachi Station: Exit B7 is closed (until the end of March 2028); use the "Sapia Tower Connection Entrance" at the far end, up the stairs from the former Exit B7 entrance (7:00-23:00)
hours: Open all year except the year-end and New Year holidays. Usage hours are in principle 9:00-21:00 (the extension fee applies to 8:00-22:00; for use outside these hours and for early-morning extension from 7:00 to 8:00, inquire). Inquiries and applications are accepted on weekdays (excluding closed days and holidays) 10:00-17:00. Usage time includes setup and cleanup time
notice: Reservations for small rooms are accepted from the first day of the month 6 months before the date of use, and for whole-floor use or larger from the first day of the month 1 year before. For 501 on the 5th floor, reservations are given priority to customers who use it combined as 501ABS (Sapia Hall). Food and drink may not be brought in; use catering. Meetings (seminars, etc.) and receptions are held in separate rooms for preparation reasons. Fees are payable by bank transfer only (no cash or cards).

ops.loadingHours: Vehicles stop temporarily at the loading area on B1F; before starting load-in or load-out, complete the procedure at the logistics reception next to it and receive a security card. Load-in is not possible without bringing a copy of the work notice submitted in advance. The procedure is done by the on-site person in charge named on the work notice, and ID such as a driver's license is required. For load-in and load-out to the 4th, 5th and 6th floors, use elevator E1 shown on the separate route map (elevator E2 is for the hotel and offices and cannot be used). Elevator E1 has a door 1,100 mm wide x 2,390 mm high and a car 1,800 mm wide x 2,000 mm deep x 2,400 mm high (up to 3,600 mm), with a capacity of 2,500 kg. Packages sent in advance arrive in the afternoon of the day before the use date at a specified date and time; storage is free up to 3 items (from the 4th item, a fee applies). (Source: Load-in and Load-out Guide, FAQ)
ops.vehicleRules: Vehicles are parked temporarily at the loading area on B1F. The height limit on B1F is up to 2.7 m. An advance application is required for load-in by vehicle. Organizing, guiding and security for visitors' cars and the like are the organizer's responsibility (when there are many visitors, the facility arranges it and the cost is borne by the organizer). (Source: Load-in and Load-out Guide, FAQ, Usage Rules Article 13)
ops.parking: If you come by car, use the hourly parking lot in the building. The parking lot is on B2F and B3F.
ops.waitingRooms: Customers of Station Conference Tokyo can use the private rooms of the lounge facility "Recross" on the 4th floor at the visitor rate, for a speaker's waiting room or a meeting before a conference. There are 3 types of private room: R-001 (1-2 people) 4,400 yen per hour, R-006 (6-8 people) 8,800 yen per hour, and R-010 (10 people) 11,000 yen per hour (tax included). Reserve by phone from 1 month before the use date; cancellation on the day of use is charged in full as a cancellation fee. At the reception you are asked the name of the event that day. Food and drink may not be brought into Recross.
ops.catering: For hygiene management, food and drink may not be brought in. Use the catering service. The facility introduces drinks (PET bottles, pot service, and a drink corner accepted from 50 people), boxed meals and light meals (Nihonbashi Daimasu, Shimogamosaryo, MASUMOTO, NADAMAN, SANKEIKAIKAN, Meijiza, and Dining & Bar TENQOO on the 27th floor of Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Marunouchi), and party plans for receptions (Tokyo Kaikan, Palace Hotel Tokyo, Hotel Metropolitan Edmont Tokyo, FUORICLASSE, SANKEIKAIKAN, Aporte Food Factory, CATERING Beyond, Gohon, CB SERVICE, DYNAC). The guide unit price for party plans is 4,400 to 14,500 yen (the minimum number of people differs by company, such as 30 or more or 50 or more). If the number of people increases on the day, food cannot be added, and drinks are handled at an additional charge. If the number of people decreases on the day, there is no discount. The catering order deadline is 12:00 three days before the use date. (Source: Catering page, FAQ)
ops.restaurants: There are shops on the 1st and 3rd floors of the same Sapia Tower, and convenience stores and restaurants on the lower floors. Hotel Metropolitan Tokyo Marunouchi occupies the 27th to 34th floors.
